about_the_game:
S.Y.N.C. – One Mecha, Two Pilots is a co-op boss-rush game as explosive as it is absurd, where two players share control of a single 40-meter-tall mecha. One handles the left arm, the other the right. Think walking in a straight line is easy? Try doing it when perfect synchronization is required. Now imagine swinging a giant two-handed hammer while a Kaiju charges straight at you…

Welcome to a world ruled by The Kid—a 7-year-old child who governs the planet like it’s a reality TV show. Ridiculous costumes are mandatory. Over-the-top poses come with every interaction. And the ultimate goal? Win the Grand Mecha-Brawl Tournament™, a global showdown of giant mechs. You're the underdogs, and your mission is simple: win 12 over-the-top battles against increasingly bizarre monsters… and earn your mecha’s weight in candy.

S.Y.N.C. delivers instant fun, epic fails, clutch plays, and loud laughter.
Play in local or online co-op, communicate, improvise, sync up… or blow up mid-air in dramatic slow motion.
Competitive? The 2v2 PvP mode lets you test your duo against other pilot teams in full-blown chaos.

What to expect:

  • One mecha, two brains: mandatory co-op, crucial coordination, guaranteed chaos

  • A wildly eccentric world ruled by a moody child overlord

  • Ridiculous Kaiju bosses with absurd yet deadly attacks

  • Two-handed weapons operated by both players—powerful… or painfully awkward

  • A 2v2 PvP mode to put your team synergy to the test

  • Designed for fun, replayability, and unforgettable moments

  • A small price for a big show

Strike your best pose. The brawl begins.
